title: Lithic pill button
description: A 32px pill in four fills (orange, dark, glassy on dark panels, white on tinted panels) with a trailing arrow. Text warms to orange on the glassy one; the others ease a shade over 0.2s.
notes: glass is for dark panels (white at 25%)
light is for the tinted bands: white fill, accent-foreground text
name: lithic-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: orange · dark: ink fill (the header's "Dashboard") · glass: white/25 on dark panels · light: white on tinted bands

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link
